en.title: Schubert: String Quartet No. 14, II. Andante con moto – Listening Guide
en.overview: This movement opens with a quiet tune in G minor. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so treat them as a guide. Listen for the shifts between G minor (darker), B-flat major and G major (brighter), and for big swings between very soft and very loud. A computer estimate puts the loudest point at [m. 73]. The movement ends very softly in G major.

listening_points.headline: The quiet opening tune
listening_points.text: The first violin leads with the opening tune in G minor, very softly [m. 1-3]. The four instruments move together in chords, which is called homophonic texture. Remember this quiet, dark sound as your starting point.

listening_points.headline: Growing louder
listening_points.text: The music is still in G minor. A marking for getting louder at [m. 9] leads to loud at [m. 11]. The first violin leads, and the cello leads at [m. 13]. A marking for getting softer appears at [m. 13].

listening_points.headline: A brighter turn to B-flat major
listening_points.text: The key brightens to B-flat major [m. 14-19]. The volume drops to soft [m. 15], then very soft [m. 17]. The second violin leads at first, then the first violin takes over.

listening_points.headline: Back to minor, then a G major glow
listening_points.text: The music returns to G minor [m. 20-21], then settles in G major [m. 22-25]. The cello probably leads for a moment, though this is uncertain. A marking for getting louder appears at [m. 21].

listening_points.headline: A slower, hushed section
listening_points.text: A new section marked lento (slow) begins very softly [m. 25]. The first violin has the tune and the others accompany. The cello leads at the end of the section [m. 31a-32b].

listening_points.headline: Louder, then fading in B-flat major
listening_points.text: The next section starts soft and reaches loud at [m. 35]. The first violin leads. Then the music turns to B-flat major [m. 38]. A marking for getting softer appears at [m. 40], and the volume is very soft at [m. 41].

listening_points.headline: Largo: a slower, soft passage
listening_points.text: A largo (very slow) section begins in soft G major, moving to G minor at [m. 50]. The lead is unclear here, though the first violin probably has the tune. The others accompany.

listening_points.headline: Loud burst, then a hush
listening_points.text: After markings for getting louder at [m. 57-58], the music reaches loud at [m. 59], where the parts move as independent lines. It then softens to soft [m. 63] and very soft [m. 65], with B-flat major in between. G major returns at [m. 70].

listening_points.headline: The estimated loudest point
listening_points.text: A computer estimate marks [m. 73] as the loudest point. It is very loud (ff). The four instruments play in chords in G minor [m. 74-75]. Then it drops suddenly to soft at [m. 76].

listening_points.headline: Loud, busy, interwoven lines
listening_points.text: This stretch stays loud and the parts move independently. The second violin probably leads, but with low confidence, so the lead is better heard as shared. The key moves from G minor to B-flat major at [m. 86].

listening_points.headline: Very soft, then a swell to a very loud close
listening_points.text: The music is very soft and in chords [m. 93-94]. A marking for getting louder at [m. 93] leads to very loud at [m. 95]. The loud chords close this part in G minor.

listening_points.headline: Largo in G major
listening_points.text: A largo section settles in G major, very softly. The first violin probably has the tune, with the others accompanying. The lead is uncertain here.

listening_points.headline: A shadowy turn to E minor
listening_points.text: The key moves to E minor, a darker colour [m. 105-111]. It then brightens to G major at [m. 112]. It stays very soft the whole way, with the first violin leading over accompaniment.

listening_points.headline: Back to G minor, ending very loud
listening_points.text: G minor returns and the music is very soft [m. 121-127]. There is a marking for getting louder at [m. 124]. At the end it reaches very loud [m. 127a-128b], with the first violin leading.

listening_points.headline: Cello comes forward
listening_points.text: The volume is now medium loud [m. 129]. The cello probably leads for much of this section, though the lead is often shared. It reaches loud at [m. 137]. A marking for getting softer appears at [m. 142], and the volume is soft at [m. 143].

listening_points.headline: Dropping toward silence
listening_points.text: The music drops to very soft at [m. 145]. One measure is labelled as a trio, meaning three parts [m. 146]. It falls to extremely soft at [m. 153]. The key moves between G minor and B-flat major.

listening_points.headline: A gentle close in G major
listening_points.text: The key settles on a bright G major and stays extremely soft [m. 158-170]. The parts mostly play in chords, and the lead is often shared. A final largo [m. 171-172] ends very softly.

glossary.explanation: All the instruments move together, like a hymn with chords.
One instrument has the tune while the others support it.
Each instrument plays its own line at the same time.
Italian words for slow and very slow.
The home note and scale the music centres on. Minor sounds darker and major sounds brighter.
A marking to get gradually softer.
A marking to get gradually louder.
A texture of three parts playing together.

zh.title: 舒伯特：D小调弦乐四重奏（“死神与少女”）第二乐章 Andante con moto——听赏指南
zh.overview: 本乐章以一段安静的 G 小调音乐开始。G 小调、降 B 大调、G 小调、G 大调这样的调性顺序在后面多次出现，每次的力度和织体都有变化。请注意第一小提琴与其他声部之间的接力，留意从很弱到很强的突然转变，也留意明亮的大调片段。和声与调性由软件自动估计，可能有误。谱面识别质量良好，但细节仍可能不够精确。电脑估计的最强点在第 73 小节。

listening_points.headline: 很弱的 G 小调开场
listening_points.text: 乐章以很弱（pp）的声音开始，是主调织体，也就是各声部一起走和弦。调性为 G 小调。第一小提琴领头 [m. 1-3]。第 4-5 小节的领头者很不确定，可视为几个声部共享。

listening_points.headline: 从渐强到强
listening_points.text: 第 9 小节标有渐强，但声音仍是很弱。到第 11 小节力度达到强（f）。第 13 小节出现渐弱标记，此处大提琴领头。

listening_points.headline: 转入降 B 大调，声音渐柔
listening_points.text: 第 14 小节起转入降 B 大调，色彩比 G 小调明亮。第 15 小节变弱（p），第 17 小节变得更弱（pp）。第 16 小节是旋律加伴奏的织体。

listening_points.headline: 短暂的 G 大调
listening_points.text: 第 22 小节起转入 G 大调，第 23 小节标有渐强和渐弱。调性稍显明亮。第 25 小节力度是很弱。

listening_points.headline: 慢速段：小提琴唱歌，其余伴奏
listening_points.text: 第三段标为 lento（慢），回到 G 小调。第一小提琴领旋律，其余声部伴奏。力度保持很弱（pp）。

listening_points.headline: 从弱到强的强烈段落
listening_points.text: 第 33 小节起为弱（p），并带渐强标记。第 35 小节力度达到强（f）。第一小提琴继续领头，其余声部伴奏。

listening_points.headline: 降 B 大调再现，渐归宁静
listening_points.text: 第 38 小节转入降 B 大调，随后变弱（p）。第 40 小节有渐弱标记。第 41 小节起很弱（pp）。第 43 小节回到 G 小调。

listening_points.headline: Largo（很慢）段，领头者不明确
listening_points.text: 第 49 小节起标为 largo（很慢），力度为弱（p）。第一小提琴大概领旋律，但把握不大。第 54-56 小节领头者不明确，可视为几个声部共享。

listening_points.headline: 又一次渐强到强，然后回落
listening_points.text: 第 57 小节有渐强，第 59 小节达到强（f）。此处各声部像是各走各的线条。第 63 小节变弱（p），第 65 小节再降到很弱（pp）。

listening_points.headline: 分析估计的高潮：突然的 ff
listening_points.text: 第 73 小节力度忽然变得很强（ff）。分析估计这里是最响、最忙的点。第 76 小节又突然回到弱（p）。领头声部很不明确，中提琴和第二小提琴可能是重点。

listening_points.headline: 声部交织，再到 ff
listening_points.text: 第 81-88 小节力度为强（f），各声部独立交织，第二小提琴可能领头，但把握不大。第 89 小节转为很弱（pp）。第 93 小节标有渐强，第 95 小节达到很强（ff）。

listening_points.headline: 很弱的 G 大调 largo
listening_points.text: 第 97 小节起为 largo，调性是明亮的 G 大调，力度很弱（pp）。第一小提琴大概领旋律，但把握一般。

listening_points.headline: E 小调的转折，再回 G 大调
listening_points.text: 第 105 小节转入 E 小调，色调变暗。第 112 小节起回到 G 大调。整段保持很弱（pp）。

listening_points.headline: G 小调回归，以 ff 收束
listening_points.text: 第 122 小节回到 G 小调，力度很弱，第 124 小节有渐强标记。第 127a 小节力度变得很强（ff）。第一小提琴领头。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴可能走到前台
listening_points.text: 第 129 小节起力度为中强（mf）。大提琴可能是领头声部，但把握不高。第 137 小节变强（f），第 143 小节变弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 降到极弱（ppp）
listening_points.text: 第 145 小节起力度很弱（pp）。第 146 小节是三个声部的织体。第 153 小节降到更弱的 ppp。第 151-154 小节再次出现降 B 大调。

listening_points.headline: G 大调的安静尾声
listening_points.text: 第 158 小节起进入 G 大调，力度保持极弱（ppp）。第 161 小节起以主调织体为主。第 171 小节标有渐强，第 172 小节以很弱（pp）结束。

glossary.explanation: 各声部节奏相近，一起走和弦的写法。
一个声部唱旋律，其余声部在下面伴奏。
声音逐渐变响/变轻。没有标记时，力度变化是突然的。
音乐转到另一个调，色彩随之变明或变暗。
从很弱、弱、中强、强到很强的力度符号。ppp 比 pp 还弱。
